description: This Java class 'EntityUtilProperties' provides utility methods for managing entity-related properties, including retrieving, comparing, and setting configuration properties, often with database integration via Delegator and SystemProperty entities.

classes.name: EntityUtilProperties
classes.description: Final utility class providing methods to access and manipulate entity configuration properties, including database-backed properties and resource bundle management.

methods.name: getSystemPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves property value from database SystemProperty table, indicating existence and value.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Checks if property value equals a given string.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if property value equals a given string, ignoring case, with database override.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves property value with database override, with default fallback.

methods.name: getPropertyValueFromDelegatorName
methods.description: Retrieves property value using a specified delegator name.

methods.name: getPropertyNumber
methods.description: Retrieves numeric property value.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves property as Boolean.

methods.name: getPropertyAsInteger
methods.description: Retrieves property as Integer.

methods.name: getPropertyAsLong
methods.description: Retrieves property as Long.

methods.name: getPropertyAsFloat
methods.description: Retrieves property as Float.

methods.name: getPropertyAsDouble
methods.description: Retrieves property as Double.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBigInteger
methods.description: Retrieves property as BigInteger.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBigDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves property as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Overloaded method to get property value with delegator context.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Loads Properties object from resource or URL, optionally with database overrides.

methods.name: setPropertyValueInMemory
methods.description: Sets a property value in memory.

methods.name: setPropertyValue
methods.description: Sets a property value in the database via Delegator.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves localized message, with database override if applicable.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Loads resource bundle for localization.

methods.name: createResourceName
methods.description: Creates resource name based on locale and extension removal.

methods.name: isPropertiesResourceNotFound
methods.description: Checks if properties resource is missing for a locale.

methods.name: resolvePropertiesUrl
methods.description: Resolves URL for properties resource based on locale.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Converts XML input stream to Properties object.
